title: Aaron Rodgers just left Mike McCarthy, Steelers in untenable situation

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers just left Mike McCarthy, Steelers in untenable situation
sources.description: No matter what percentage of Rodgers' allegations against McCarthy are true, Rodgers' 30+-minute segment on ESPN railing against his longtime colleague who remains the head coach of an NFL team will not be ignored.
